summary.intent: Complete Phase 45 (Rust-only FUSE write-journal/replay hygiene refactor) end-to-end through all GSD gates: plan, execute, verify, code-review, secure, validate, push, and simplify.
summary.outcome: Phase 45 fully closed: 6/6 plans executed, 266 tests green, all GSD gates passed (verify 7/7, code-review 0 real blockers, security 0 open threats ASVS L1, Nyquist compliant). PR #491 opened and PR body corrected. Simplify pass applied to journal_helpers.rs.

repo: Crate is `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse`; winfsp path (crates/fuse/src/platform/windows) can't compile on macOS due to Windows-only `winfsp-sys`/`windows-*` deps — it's CI-gated only.

`publish_file_metadata` pre-existed in operations.rs:125 with identical conflict-swallowing behavior (Conflict => warn => Ok => record_publish) and was already called by the live release path before Phase 45; the pre-refactor inline replay also swallowed conflict identically.
`cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` is `pub use ecies::wrap_key` — all wrap-to-hex sites across the crate can be unified to a single idiom safely.
Running `cargo fmt` on a newly added module (journal_helpers.rs in 45-06) reformats the entire crate package, leaving ~14 out-of-scope files dirty with pure whitespace/style changes.
`gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo because it queries deprecated Projects-classic; must use `gh api -X PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number} -F body=@file` to update PR body.
Bare `#NN` in PR body auto-links as GFM issue/PR references; wrap in backticks (`` `[#11]` ``) to render literally when there are no corresponding issues.
The gsd-tools `commit_failed` false negative: the error body can be successful lint-staged output; always verify via `git log` rather than trusting the return value.

code.finding: Both builders duplicated `SystemTime::now()…as_millis()` (now_ms), `hex::encode(generate_random_bytes(16))` (entry-id), and divergent wrap-to-hex idioms; also contained a dead `wrapped_key_hex` alias that was a pointless rename-clone of `encrypted_file_key_hex`. All fixed in simplify pass.
File key is zeroized here — confirms T-45-06-CRYPTO threat is closed; ciphertext-only journal, single ECIES wrap.

`write_generation += 1` bump (was line 297 pre-refactor); fuser path bumps in handle_write and reads at release — unchanged pre→post Phase 45. The fuser/winfsp write_generation asymmetry is pre-existing platform design, not a regression.
`publish_file_metadata` pre-existed here with conflict-swallowing semantics; Phase 45 plan 45-05 reused it in replay rather than introducing new behavior.

workflow: Deep code review can generate credible-looking false-positive blockers — always verify against the actual pre/post diff and git history before accepting or dismissing them, especially for no-behavior-change refactors.
Stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0308, unlinked-file) can persist for minutes after edits and look like real compile errors; `cargo check --workspace` exit code is ground truth.

When waves are mostly serial due to a shared bottleneck file (lib.rs), sequential executor runs on the feature branch are safer than worktrees — the parallel-write conflict risk outweighs the wall-clock benefit.
After a full-phase simplify pass on a Rust file, format only that specific file (`rustfmt path/to/file.rs`) rather than `cargo fmt` to avoid whole-crate scope drift in the PR diff.
GSD gate sequence for a complete phase: plan → execute → verify (goal) → code-review → secure-phase → validate-phase → ship. Each gate produces a committed artifact in .planning/phases/.
TDD RED→GREEN sequences should be verified in git log history as part of post-execution gate checks, not just claimed by the executor.

friction: `gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo due to deprecated Projects-classic queries — required falling back to `gh api -X PATCH` REST call to update PR body.
Plan 45-06 executor returned a thin summary with no test/check confirmations despite being the riskiest refactor, requiring manual ground-truth verification of workspace check and winfsp cross-check.
Stale rust-analyzer cache produced convincing E0308 errors after 45-03 and 45-06 that required running actual `cargo check` to disprove.
Deep code reviewer raised 2 'blocker' findings (CR-01 conflict handling, CR-02 write_generation) that required non-trivial investigation against pre/post diff before being proven false-positive.
Stray whole-crate `cargo fmt` triggered by 45-06's new module left 14 out-of-scope files dirty, requiring explicit `git checkout -- crates/` discard and re-verification.
GitHub push timed out on first attempt (transient network issue) before succeeding on retry.
gsd-tools `commit_failed` false negative for validation commit required `git log` verification to confirm it actually landed.
open_items: PR #491 CI still running (PR-title check, build/test, signature verification) — worth checking once it reports.
github-actions[bot] may push a `chore(release)` commit onto feat/desktop-fuse-write-durability-cleanup after PR creation; local commits would need `git fetch && git rebase` before pushing.
Three pre-existing warnings noted in deep code review but left out-of-scope: atomicity of `update_status`, `Zeroizing` on plaintext keys, `deser_opt_string` applied to `file_ipns_key_hex` field.
winfsp Windows path (journal_helpers consolidation) is manual/CI-only — not locally testable on macOS; relies on Windows CI runner for full coverage of plan 45-06.
REQUIREMENTS traceability had 5 pre-existing gaps flagged during completion (unrelated to Phase 45 scope) — not addressed.
